source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: From battle round 2, check your [Gate of Infinity](vsdata:ability/grey-knights.gate-of-infinity) picks on the preceding opponent turn. If you used fewer than the maximum, you may, as your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) opens, choose one GREY KNIGHTS unit on the field that could have been picked. Remove it into [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves). It remains on the field during [Command](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) and can return elsewhere during that [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase)’s Reinforcements step.

trigger.requires: selected fewer than the Gate of Infinity maximum at end of previous opponent turn

effect.procedure: remove then place in Strategic Reserves
